/* bmsInab.selectInPlanList : 반입예정 리스트 조회 */
SELECT AA.* , COUNT(*) OVER() AS TOTAL_CNT , SUM(AA.SIMPLE_CNT) OVER() AS TOTAL_SIMPLE_CNT , SUM(AA.GENERAL_CNT) OVER() AS TOTAL_GENERAL_CNT FROM ( SELECT A.IN_PLAN_NO , IIF(A.CD_TYPE = 'Y', 1, 0) AS SIMPLE_CNT , IIF(A.CD_TYPE = 'N', 1, 0) AS GENERAL_CNT
, A.CD_TYPE + '.' + (SELECT NAME_${userLanguage} FROM TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL WHERE ENT_CODE = #{srchEntCode} AND GROUP_CODE = 'CD_TYPE' AND CODE = A.CD_TYPE) AS CD_TYPE , A.CD_USE_TYPE + '.' + (SELECT NAME_${userLanguage} FROM TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL WHERE ENT_CODE = #{srchEntCode} AND GROUP_CODE = 'USE_GUBN' AND CODE = A.CD_USE_TYPE ) AS CD_USE_TYPE , A.ECM_TYPE + '.' + (SELECT NAME_${userLanguage} FROM TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL WHERE ENT_CODE = #{srchEntCode} AND GROUP_CODE = 'CCL_ECOMMERCE_TYPE' AND CODE = A.ECM_TYPE) AS ECM_TYPE , A.SE_INSPECTION_CODE + '.' + (SELECT NAME_${userLanguage} FROM TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL WHERE ENT_CODE = #{srchEntCode} AND GROUP_CODE = 'SE_INSPECTION_CODE' AND CODE = A.SE_INSPECTION_CODE) AS SE_INSPECTION_CODE , A.INSPECTION_TYPE + '.' + (SELECT NAME_${userLanguage} FROM TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL WHERE ENT_CODE = #{srchEntCode} AND GROUP_CODE = 'INSPECTION_TYPE' AND CODE = A.INSPECTION_TYPE) AS INSPECTION_TYPE , A.INSPECTION_TYPE_A + '.' + (SELECT NAME_${userLanguage} FROM TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL WHERE ENT_CODE = #{srchEntCode} AND GROUP_CODE = 'INSPECTION_TYPE' AND CODE = A.INSPECTION_TYPE_A) AS INSPECTION_TYPE_A , A.INSPECTION_TYPE_B + '.' + (SELECT NAME_${userLanguage} FROM TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL WHERE ENT_CODE = #{srchEntCode} AND GROUP_CODE = 'INSPECTION_TYPE' AND CODE = A.INSPECTION_TYPE_B) AS INSPECTION_TYPE_B , A.PALN5EM_INSPECTION_CODE + '.' + (SELECT NAME_${userLanguage} FROM TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL WHERE ENT_CODE = #{srchEntCode} AND GROUP_CODE = 'SE_INSPECTION_CODE' AND CODE = A.PALN5EM_INSPECTION_CODE) AS PALN5EM_INSPECTION_CODE , xr.XRAY_INSPECTION_CODE + '.' + (SELECT NAME_${userLanguage} FROM TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL WHERE ENT_CODE = #{srchEntCode} AND GROUP_CODE = 'SE_INSPECTION_CODE' AND CODE = xr.XRAY_INSPECTION_CODE) AS XRAY_INSPECTION_CODE , (SELECT NAME_${userLanguage} FROM TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL WHERE ENT_CODE = #{srchEntCode} AND GROUP_CODE = 'XRAY_LINE_NO' AND CODE = xr.XRAY_LINE_NO) AS XRAY_LINE_NO
, A.CD_TYPE , A.ECM_TYPE , A.CD_USE_TYPE , A.SE_INSPECTION_CODE , A.INSPECTION_TYPE , A.INSPECTION_TYPE_A , A.INSPECTION_TYPE_B , A.PALN5EM_INSPECTION_CODE , xr.XRAY_INSPECTION_CODE , xr.XRAY_LINE_NO
, A.NOTIFY_DATE_TIME , A.IN_APPROVAL_NO , A.TRANS_PERIOD_DATE , A.DEPARTURE_LOCATION , A.LAST_LOCATION , A.REPORT_EMPLOYEE_TEL , A.OD_JOB_NO , A.CARGO_REFERENCE_NO , CASE WHEN LEN(A.CARGO_REFERENCE_NO) > 15 THEN ( SUBSTRING(A.CARGO_REFERENCE_NO, 1, 11) + '-' + SUBSTRING(A.CARGO_REFERENCE_NO, 12, 4) + '-' + SUBSTRING(A.CARGO_REFERENCE_NO, 16, 4) ) ELSE SUBSTRING(A.CARGO_REFERENCE_NO, 1, 11) + '-' + SUBSTRING(A.CARGO_REFERENCE_NO, 12, 4) END AS CARGO_REFERENCE_NO_DISP , A.BL_NO , A.MBL_NO , A.INSPECT_YN , A.NOTICE_INSPECT_YN , A.PKG_TYPE , A.EX_CT , A.EX_WT , A.EX_CBM , A.CUSTOMS_CODE , A.CUSTOMS_DPT_CODE , A.VESSEL_FLIGHT , A.VOYAGE , A.AR_DATE , A.AR_TIME , A.COMMODITY_ITEM_LOC , A.SHIPPER_CODE , A.SHIPPER_NAME , A.SHIPPER_ADDRESS_1 , A.SHIPPER_ADDRESS_2 , A.CONSIGNEE_CODE , A.CONSIGNEE_NAME , A.CONSIGNEE_ADDRESS_1 , A.CONSIGNEE_ADDRESS_2 , dbo.Cryptography(A.OD_JOB_NO, A.CONSIGNEE_BUSINESS_ID, 1) AS CONSIGNEE_BUSINESS_ID , dbo.Cryptography(A.OD_JOB_NO, A.CONSIGNEE_TEL, 1) AS CONSIGNEE_TEL , A.NOTIFY_CODE , A.NOTIFY_NAME , A.NOTIFY_ADDRESS_1 , A.NOTIFY_ADDRESS_2 , dbo.Cryptography(A.OD_JOB_NO, A.NOTIFY_TEL, 1) AS NOTIFY_TEL , A.SPECIAL_CODE_1 , A.SPECIAL_CODE_2 , A.SPECIAL_CODE_3 , A.CARRIER_CODE , A.CNTR_NO , A.ORIG_COUNTRY , A.SIMPLE_AUTH_NAME , A.BIG_SIZE_YN , A.AMOUNT_USD , A.IN_SCAN_DATE_TIME , A.REFERENCE_NO , A.IN_YN , A.REGISTER_USER_ID , (SELECT tsu.USER_NAME FROM TB_SMS_USER tsu WHERE tsu.USER_ID = A.REGISTER_USER_ID) AS REGISTER_USER_NAME , A.REGISTER_DATE_TIME , A.UPDATE_USER_ID , (SELECT tsu.USER_NAME FROM TB_SMS_USER tsu WHERE tsu.USER_ID = A.UPDATE_USER_ID) AS UPDATE_USER_NAME , A.UPDATE_DATE_TIME , '' AS LAST_POD_STATUS , ISNULL(oh.HOLD_YN,'N') AS HOLD_YN , oh.HOLD_CODE , oh.HOLD_REASON , oh.HOLD_RELEASE_YN , oh.HOLD_RELEASE_ATTN , (SELECT tsu.USER_NAME FROM TB_SMS_USER tsu WHERE tsu.USER_ID = oh.HOLD_RELEASE_ATTN) AS HOLD_RELEASE_ATTN_NAME , oh.HOLD_RELEASE_DATE , xr.XRAY_SCAN_CT , xr.XRAY_IMAGE_CT , xr.RESEND_YN , CASE WHEN (SELECT TOP 1 REFERENCE_NO_ID FROM TB_COM_FILE_SHARE WHERE FUNC_JOB_NO = A.OD_JOB_NO) IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END AS FILE_SHARE , A.MGN_ISSUE_YN , A.CRIME_SELECTION_YN FROM TB_BMS_IN_PLAN A WITH (NOLOCK) LEFT JOIN (SELECT '' AS HOLD_YN , MAX(OD_JOB_NO) AS OD_JOB_NO , MAX(HOLD_CODE) AS HOLD_CODE , MAX(HOLD_REASON) AS HOLD_REASON , MAX(HOLD_RELEASE_YN) AS HOLD_RELEASE_YN , MAX(HOLD_RELEASE_ATTN) AS HOLD_RELEASE_ATTN , MAX(HOLD_RELEASE_DATE) AS HOLD_RELEASE_DATE FROM TB_ECM_OD_HOLD GROUP BY OD_JOB_NO) oh ON oh.OD_JOB_NO = A.OD_JOB_NO LEFT JOIN TB_BMS_XRAY_RESULT xr ON xr.IN_PLAN_NO = A.IN_PLAN_NO LEFT JOIN TB_BMS_ABNORMAL_BL ab ON ab.CARGO_REFERENCE_NO = A.CARGO_REFERENCE_NO
AND 1 = 0
AND ab.CARGO_REFERENCE_NO IS NULL AND A.IN_APPROVAL_NO = '' ) AA

/* bmsInab.selectAbnormalList : 반입이상 리스트 조회 */
SELECT AA.* , COUNT(*) OVER() AS TOTAL_CNT FROM ( SELECT A.ABN_NO , A.CUSTOMS_REPORT_NO , A.MRN , A.MSN , A.MBL_NO , A.LAST_POD_DATE
, (SELECT NAME_${userLanguage} FROM TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL WHERE ENT_CODE = #{srchEntCode} AND GROUP_CODE = 'STATUS_ORDER_CARGO' AND CODE = A.LAST_POD_STATUS) AS LAST_POD_STATUS
, A.LAST_POD_STATUS
, A.LAST_POD_RAQ_DATE , A.VESSEL_FLIGHT , A.VOYAGE , A.AR_DATE , A.AR_TIME , A.ABN_REQ_DATE , A.REGISTER_USER_ID , (SELECT tsu.USER_NAME FROM TB_SMS_USER tsu WHERE tsu.USER_ID = A.REGISTER_USER_ID) AS REGISTER_USER_NAME , A.REGISTER_DATE_TIME , A.UPDATE_USER_ID , (SELECT tsu.USER_NAME FROM TB_SMS_USER tsu WHERE tsu.USER_ID = A.UPDATE_USER_ID) AS UPDATE_USER_NAME , A.UPDATE_DATE_TIME , (SELECT BMS_CUSTOMS_CODE FROM TB_SMS_ENT_BUSINESS WHERE ENT_CODE =#{entCode} AND ENT_BUSINESS_CODE = #{entBusinessCode}) AS CUSTOMS_CODE , (SELECT BMS_CUSTOMS_DPT_CODE FROM TB_SMS_ENT_BUSINESS WHERE ENT_CODE =#{entCode} AND ENT_BUSINESS_CODE = #{entBusinessCode}) AS CUSTOMS_DPT_CODE FROM TB_BMS_ABNORMAL A
AND 1 = 0
) AA
SELECT COUNT(*) AS CNT FROM TB_BMS_ABNORMAL WHERE ABN_NO = #{abnNo}
SELECT COUNT(*) AS CNT FROM TB_BMS_ABNORMAL_BL WHERE 1 = 1 AND CARGO_REFERENCE_NO = #{cargoReferenceNo}
SELECT MBL_NO FROM TB_BMS_IN_PLAN WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE BL_NO = #{blNo}
SELECT COUNT(*) AS CNT FROM TB_BMS_IN_PLAN WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE IN_PLAN_NO = #{inPlanNo}

SELECT A.ABN_NO , A.CUSTOMS_REPORT_NO , A.MRN , A.MSN , A.MBL_NO , A.LAST_POD_DATE , A.LAST_POD_STATUS , A.LAST_POD_RAQ_DATE , A.VESSEL_FLIGHT , A.VOYAGE , A.AR_DATE , A.AR_TIME , A.ABN_REQ_DATE , A.REGISTER_USER_ID , (SELECT tsu.USER_NAME FROM TB_SMS_USER tsu WHERE tsu.USER_ID = A.REGISTER_USER_ID) AS REGISTER_USER_NAME , A.REGISTER_DATE_TIME , A.UPDATE_USER_ID , (SELECT tsu.USER_NAME FROM TB_SMS_USER tsu WHERE tsu.USER_ID = A.UPDATE_USER_ID) AS UPDATE_USER_NAME , A.UPDATE_DATE_TIME , (SELECT BMS_CUSTOMS_CODE FROM TB_SMS_ENT_BUSINESS WHERE ENT_CODE =#{entCode} AND ENT_BUSINESS_CODE = #{entBusinessCode}) AS CUSTOMS_CODE , (SELECT BMS_CUSTOMS_DPT_CODE FROM TB_SMS_ENT_BUSINESS WHERE ENT_CODE =#{entCode} AND ENT_BUSINESS_CODE = #{entBusinessCode}) AS CUSTOMS_DPT_CODE FROM TB_BMS_ABNORMAL A WHERE 1 = 1 AND A.ABN_NO = #{abnNo} AND A.MBL_NO = #{mblNo}
AND AR_DATE = #{arDate}

SELECT AA.* , COUNT(*) OVER() AS TOTAL_CNT FROM ( SELECT A.ABN_NO , A.CUSTOMS_REPORT_NO , A.MRN , A.MSN , A.MBL_NO , A.LAST_POD_DATE , A.LAST_POD_STATUS , A.LAST_POD_RAQ_DATE , A.VESSEL_FLIGHT , A.VOYAGE , A.AR_DATE , A.AR_TIME , A.ABN_REQ_DATE , A.REGISTER_USER_ID , (SELECT tsu.USER_NAME FROM TB_SMS_USER tsu WHERE tsu.USER_ID = A.REGISTER_USER_ID) AS REGISTER_USER_NAME , A.REGISTER_DATE_TIME , A.UPDATE_USER_ID , (SELECT tsu.USER_NAME FROM TB_SMS_USER tsu WHERE tsu.USER_ID = A.UPDATE_USER_ID) AS UPDATE_USER_NAME , A.UPDATE_DATE_TIME , ab.SEQ_NO , ab.CARGO_REFERENCE_NO , ab.HSN , ab.BL_NO , ab.PKG_TYPE , ab.EX_CT , ab.EX_WT , ab.CT , ab.WT , ab.ACCIDENT_CLASS , ab.ACCIDENT_CT , ab.ACCIDENT_WT , ab.REJECT_REASON , ip.OD_JOB_NO , 'Y' AS ABN_YN FROM TB_BMS_ABNORMAL_BL ab LEFT JOIN TB_BMS_ABNORMAL A ON A.ABN_NO = ab.ABN_NO LEFT JOIN TB_BMS_IN_PLAN ip WITH (NOLOCK) ON ip.BL_NO = ab.BL_NO WHERE 1 = 1 AND A.ABN_NO = #{abnNo} AND A.MBL_NO = #{mblNo} AND A.AR_DATE = #{arDate} ) AA
SELECT ABN_NO FROM TB_BMS_ABNORMAL WHERE CUSTOMS_REPORT_NO = #{customsReportNo}
